title: 외모 말하기: 키가 커요? 머리가 길어요?
objective: By the end, you can use 크다/작다, 많다/적다 and 길다/짧다 in their -아요/-어요 forms to describe a person's height, eyes, hands, and hair in short sentences.
summary: Learn three pairs of opposite adjectives (big/small, many/few, long/short) and simple body words to describe how people look.

task.title: Use the opposite words
task.line: Write the opposite, choose a word, fill the blank, or answer in Korean using the -아요/-어요 form.

words.meaning: big; with 키 (height), it means tall
small; with 키, it means short (in height)
words.exampleMeaning: The baby's hands are really small.

words.meaning: to have a lot of, many (X이/가 많아요 = there is a lot of X)
words.exampleMeaning: My older brother has a lot of hair.

words.meaning: to have little or few; not much
words.exampleMeaning: My grandfather doesn't have much hair.
My older sister has long hair.

words.meaning: height (of a person); use 크다/작다, not 높다
hair (on the head); in everyday speech, often just 머리

exercises: Write the opposite word: ① 크다 ② 많다 ③ 짧다
Choose the right word: ① 개미는 아주 (커요 / 작아요). ② 기린은 목이 (길어요 / 짧아요).
Fill in the blank with 많아요 or 적어요: ① 우리 동네에는 사람이 ____. 아주 조용해요. ② 오늘은 숙제가 ____. 다섯 시간 했어요.
Fill in the blank with 길어요 or 짧아요: 제 동생은 머리가 ____. 허리까지 와요.
Read and answer in Korean: 지수 씨는 키가 작아요. 머리가 짧아요. ① 지수 씨는 키가 커요? ② 지수 씨는 머리가 짧아요?
answers: ① 작다 ② 적다 ③ 길다
① 아니요, 작아요. (아니요, 키가 작아요.) ② 네, 짧아요. (네, 머리가 짧아요.)
